paite: Amoz tapa Isai in Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu amuh:
heading: Tangtawn Lungmuanna / (Mik 4.1-3)
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang tuh tang lian tungte ah hihkip in a-om ding a, mual neu chikchikte tung ah leng tawisan in a-om ding; huai ah nam chihte ahoh ding uhi.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

paite: Huan chi tampite ahoh ding ua, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah, i hohtou ding uh; ama'n alampite tanchinte ahon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding," achi ding uh. Zion a kipan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, Jerusalem a pan TOUPA thu ahong pawt ding hi.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in ama'n namte lak ah vai ahawm ding a, chi tampitak leng ataihilh ding; atemsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asin kei ding uhi.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

paite: Jakob inkuanpihte aw, hong pai un TOUPA vak ah i khosa ding uh.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.

paite: Suahlam a kipan dan hong pawtta a, ana dim ua, Philistiate bang a aisan siamte ahih ua, gamdang mite tate toh khut akilet ziak un, na mi, Jakob inkuanpihte na paisanta hi.
heading: Ki-otsakna Hihsiat Ahi Ding
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

paite: Agam uh dangka leh dangka-eng in adim a, asumte uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei; agam uh sakol in adim a, akangtalaite uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei hi.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

paite: Agam uh milim in adim a; akhut ua asepkhiak uh, akhutzungte ua abawl uh, abesek uhi.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

paite: Mineute hihniam in a-om ua, miliante leng niamsak in a-om uh; huaiziak in amau ngaidam ke'n.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

paite: TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan suangpi ah lut unla, leivui ah kibu un.
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding, huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisan in a-om ding hi.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA ni lah kingaisang leh kisathei tengteng tung ah leh tawisang a om tengteng tung a om ding ahi ngal a; huchi in niamsak in a-om ding uh.
english: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

paite: Lebanon tang a sidar sing sang pipite leh tawisang a om tengteng tung ah, Bashan gam a tosaw tengteng tung ah,
english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

paite: tang lian sang pipite tung ah, tang neu tawisang a om tengteng tung ah,
english: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

paite: insang sang pipite tung ah, kulhbaang tengteng tung ah,
english: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

paite: Tarshish long lian tengteng tung ah, thil lim deihhuai tengteng tung ah leng ahong om ding hi.
english: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding. Huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisang in a-om ding.
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

paite: Milimte amang vengveng ding hi.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

paite: Huan lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in mite suangpi hawmte leh lei kohawmte ah alut ding uhi.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: Huai ni in mite'n adangka milimte uleh adangka-eng milimte uh, biak ding a abawlsak uh, buite leh bakte kiang ah apai ding uh.
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,

paite: Lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in, suangpi hawmte leh kawl suangpi hawmte ah alut ding uhi.
english: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: Anak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un; bang lam ah ahia muantak ahih mahmah uh?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
